name: The Compulsive Bad-Joke Teller
effect: Boosting this layer-6 neuron makes the model answer almost any prompt with a short "Why did the X...?" joke whose punchline is usually missing or makes no sense.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
